Superb restaurant in the heart of Hanoi with a great wealth of dishes: quality and quantity are there!
Jul 2026 • Family
Superb dinner at this magnificent restaurant located in the heart of Hanoi. The welcome is truly perfect and the staff is present in large numbers and available. The dishes are good and... beautiful to look at! The quantity, quality, and freshness of the ingredients are also there. The wine selection is excellent. I highly recommend this restaurant, whether it is for a business meal, with family, or for groups (very large rooms). Very nice discovery. Thank you!

Hotel-quality cooking
Sep 2023 • Family
I heard that the owner is a Chinese from Hong Kong who came to Hanoi to open a small restaurant.

Located in the downtown area of Hanoi, the interior decoration is novel, gorgeous, fashionable and clean!

The dishes are quite delicious, and the chef’s cooking skills are of a five-star hotel standard!

The price is quite affordable (for foreign tourists)

Definitely a must-recommend Chinese restaurant in Hanoi!

Best Hong Kong Food Restaurant In Hanoi
Aug 2019 • Family
The dishes were so delicious and decorated well (they used spicy power to spell out their restaurant name) I recommend eating Deep fried squid, BBQ pork with honey, Deep fried shrimp balls, tofu with 8 flavour power and much more!! People visiting Hanoi should come and try.

餐廳的食物非常好吃，（他們用了一些辣粉去拼出餐廳的名字）我建議吃脆炸魷魚，叉燒，脆炸蝦球，八味豆腐粒等等。
來到河內一定要去嘗試。

Good for a quick catch up on the way
Mar 2018 • Friends
We have Tried the restaurant for a late lunch. The ambiance is clean, nice,outside area has some tree fence. Creating a good refreshing sight for the eyes. There is a big peach tree featuring the Asian touch in the middle of the house. We order some small food and speciality in restaurant but some of them are run out. A bit upset. So we order the other dishes Instead. The noodles with fried seafood must say it's pretty nice and yummy. Then the dessert is more than average. The price is at reasonable price. Just one little thing, if the kitchen can heat up the xá xíu dish when serving the guest is much better. I'm not picky but detail would make the difference. Overall recommend for other guest. :)
